name: Conducttr
description: Commercial multi-channel crisis simulation platform supporting realistic crisis communications training via social media, email, SMS, phone calls, and messaging. Used by emergency management agencies, military organizations, and corporate entities for immersive crisis response exercises with realistic information flow and media dynamics.
domain: crisis communications, emergency management, military training
general_score_metric: Outcome-based metrics (exercise objectives achieved / task success rate, e.g., response time, decision accuracy)
reputation: widely adopted commercial platform; used by NATO, national emergency management agencies, and major corporations
notes: Commercial SaaS platform. Unique strength is multi-channel media simulation (social media, email, news) creating realistic information environment. Used extensively for military information operations training.
